cards.verse_text: So the Egyptians appointed taskmasters over the Israelites to oppress them with forced labor.
cards.snippet: So the Egyptians appointed taskmasters over the Israelites to oppress them with forced labor.

cards.card_text: That same day, Pharaoh gives orders to the taskmasters of the people and their foremen.
cards.verse_text: That same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their foremen:
cards.snippet: That same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their foremen:

cards.card_text: The taskmasters and foremen go out with Pharaoh's message: no more straw, get your own wherever you can find it, and your workload won't be reduced at all.
cards.verse_text: So the taskmasters and foremen of the people went out and said to them, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I am no longer giving you straw.

cards.card_text: And the taskmasters keep pressing them: “Fulfill your quota each day, just as you did when straw was provided.”

cards.card_text: Then the Israelite foremen, the ones Pharaoh's taskmasters set over the people, are beaten.
cards.verse_text: Then the Israelite foremen, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over the people, were beaten and asked, “Why have you not fulfilled your quota of bricks yesterday or today, as you did before?”
